articles.summary: Transformative increase to its asset portfolio, nearly doubling refining capacity Expands and diversifies its footprint with high-quality refineries in new distribution areas Synergistic marketing business is anticipated to provide margin uplift across integrated platform Improved positioning for potential future acquisitions and margin improvement opportunities CVR Energy, Inc. (NYSE: CVI) (“CVR Energy”) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement with subsidiaries of Marathon Petroleum Corporation (NYSE: MPC) (“Marathon”) under which CVR Energy would acquire (the “Acquisition”) Marathon’s St. Paul Park, Minnesota and Mandan, North Dakota refineries, along with Marathon’s related marketing business (collectively, the “Acquired Business”), for a total purchase price of approximately $4.2 billion, plus net working capital.
